Policy Text: Full-time US corporate employees who have completed their 90-day onboarding period are eligible for a hybrid schedule requiring at least 3 days per week in an assigned hub office.
The company provides a 100% dollar-for-dollar match on employee 401(k) contributions up to 4% of eligible base salary, with immediate 100% vesting upon enrollment.
Employees holding Series 7, 63, or 79 licenses must disclose all compensated or uncompensated outside business activities to HR Compliance prior to engagement.
Primary and secondary caregivers welcoming a child via birth, adoption, or foster placement receive 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave within 12 months of the event.

All employees with access to non-public financial metrics are prohibited from trading company equity or designated fintech partner securities starting 15 days before quarter-end until 48 hours post-earnings.
Exempt salaried employees accrue no fixed vacation balance and may take flexible PTO with manager approval; absences exceeding 10 consecutive business days require VP sign-off.
All US employees and people managers must complete state-compliant anti-harassment and bystander intervention training within 30 days of hire and annually thereafter.
Base salary merit adjustments and annual discretionary bonus evaluations occur each February for employees hired on or before October 1 of the preceding calendar year.
Employees with at least 12 months of tenure and 1,250 hours worked qualify for up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected family or medical leave under federal FMLA guidelines.
Employees must remain in their current role for a minimum of 12 months with a Meets Expectations rating or higher before applying to internal job postings.
Full-time employees receive a $1,200 annual taxable Lifestyle Spending Account reimbursed via payroll for gym memberships, mental health apps, or ergonomic home furniture.
Employees voluntarily resigning are requested to provide at least 2 weeks written notice to their direct manager; Garden Leave may be invoked for senior risk or product roles.
Employees are granted up to 10 paid bereavement days following the loss of an immediate family member and 3 paid days for extended relatives.
All new hires must complete Form I-9 identity and employment authorization verification via E-Verify no later than their third business day of employment.
Employees pursuing CFA, CPA, PMP, or accredited fintech compliance certifications qualify for up to $2,500 per calendar year in exam and study material reimbursement.
